title: BMC PatrolAgent Version Logging Format String Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of BMC PatrolAgent. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists due to a format string handling error during log message writing. Supplying an invalid version number containing format string tokens to a vulnerable target on TCP port 3181 triggers an exploitable format string vulnerability which can result in arbitrary code execution.
